_filingNote: A line with `into` and no `to` approves where a document belongs and says nothing about its name. It exists because the folder a model suggests is no more deterministic than the name it writes: runs 10264 and 10285, an hour apart, grouped the same two workbooks into a new Dashboards folder and then did not, so the folder was created once and refused the next time by the rule that a new folder must hold two documents. Pinning the destination is what makes filing repeatable, exactly as pinning the name did. The folder is created if it is not there.
